summary: Validated the new third concept /preview/chromatic alongside existing /preview/dark and /preview/light. All route loads, titles, dock active states, back/forward, no-overflow dock responsiveness (320-1920px), Nova state interactions, scorecard data-evidence attribute (quote vs gap), design-notes dialog (all 3 directions), demo booking preview-only notice, mobile menu toggle, and chromatic colour palette match verified. No console errors, no duplicate data-testids, no horizontal page overflow at any breakpoint.

dialogs.demo_notice: Design preview only. No calendar is connected and no booking request is sent.
